request.style: English, male gritty rock voice, electric guitar, acoustic guitar, bass, drums, dark and urgent mood, 90 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
The day of your death is near
Summon Joshua, stand together
Present yourselves at the tent
Where I will commission him

[Verse]
I appeared in a pillar of cloud
Standing over the entrance
You lie down with your fathers soon
But the people will rise up

[Chorus]
Write down this song for yourselves
Teach it to the Israelites
Put it in their mouths deep
So it stands as my witness

[Verse]
They prostitute themselves to foreign gods
Forsaking me and my covenant
My anger will burn against them
I will hide my face away

[Chorus]
Write down this song for yourselves
Teach it to the Israelites
Put it in their mouths deep
So it stands as my witness

[Bridge]
They eat their fill and grow fat
Then they despise my holy name
When disasters come upon them
They will say I am gone

[Outro]
This song will testify against them
It will not be lost from their lips
